concept: Heterogeneous DB migration: SCT + DMS with CDC
tests: Choosing tools for an Oracle → Aurora PostgreSQL migration with minimal downtime (choose two).
expected: AWS SCT converts the schema and stored procedures, AWS DMS moves the data and replicates changes via CDC until cutover. Triggers: "different engines (Oracle → PostgreSQL)", "heterogeneous", "minimal downtime".
why_not: DataSync copies files/objects (NFS/SMB/S3), not live databases; Snowball is offline file transfer, not a minimal-downtime migration.
